2608.29309.title: Evaluating LLM-based AI agents integrated with materials synthesis tools: the case of atomic layer deposition
2608.29309.paper_summary: This work provides an overview of the different strategies that can be used to evaluate the performance of AI models and agents based on large language models (LLMs) for materials synthesis. After providing a brief overview of the key technologies behind the current generation of AI agents based on LLMs, we summarize the different approaches to evaluating these models in the context of materials science and in particular on materials synthesis, with a specific emphasis on scenarios in which the models are directly integrated with experimental tools. We discuss evaluation strategies spanning knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, tool-use benchmarks, and closed loop benchmarks involving the interaction with experimental systems or realistic virtual tools. We use atomic layer deposition (ALD) as a case study, emphasizing how existing approaches in the literature both build from general approaches used beyond materials science and can be generalized to other materials synthesis techniques. Finally, we provide a practical evaluation framework to evaluate LLMs in the context of materials synthesis
2608.29309.paper_summary_zh: 這項工作提供了基於大型語言模型（LLMs）評估AI模型和代理性能的不同策略概述，特別是在材料合成方面。<lb/>在簡要介紹當前一代基於LLMs的AI代理背後的關鍵技術後，我們總結了在材料科學背景下評估這些模型的不同方法，特別是在材料合成方面，並特別強調模型與實驗工具直接集成的場景。<lb/>我們討論了涵蓋知識和推理基準、工具使用基準以及涉及與實驗系統或現實虛擬工具互動的閉環基準的評估策略。<lb/>我們以原子層沉積（ALD）作為案例研究，強調文獻中現有方法如何既基於材料科學以外的通用方法，又可以推廣到其他材料合成技術。<lb/>最後，我們提供了一個實用的評估框架，以在材料合成的背景下評估LLMs。
